\]
to the gate, thereby setting \(v_{GS}=v_F-v_{\rm in}\). Because the MOSFET remains in saturation for any \(v_{\rm out}>0\), the large-signal drain current is simply
\[
I_D=\frac12k_n\bigl(\alpha V_{\rm out}-V_{\rm in}-V_t\bigr)^2.

KCL at the output node then supplies the implicit input-output characteristic
\[
\frac{V_{DD}-V_{\rm out}}{R_D}=I_D+\frac{V_{\rm out}}{R_1+R_2}.
\]

\[
i_d=g_m(\alpha v_{\rm out}-v_{\rm in}),\qquad
i_d=-v_{\rm out}\Bigl(\frac1{R_D}+\frac1{R_1+R_2}\Bigr).
\]

A_v=\frac{v_{\rm out}}{v_{\rm in}}=\frac{g_m}{g_m\alpha+1/R_{\rm eq}},
\]
where \(R_{\rm eq}=R_D\parallel(R_1+R_2)\). When the loop gain is large the gain collapses to the reciprocal of the feedback factor, \(A_v\simeq1/\alpha\). The resistance seen at the source is
\[
R_{\rm in}=\frac1{g_m}+\alpha R_{\rm eq}.
\]
(The same topology realizes a voltage amplifier: series mixing at the \(v_{GS}\) port and shunt sampling at the drain.)
